notes.content: Admission Recommendations for the School of Engineering

Thank you for your interest in Santa Clara University! This guide has been designed to help make the course-planning process easier for students who wish to transfer to Santa Clara University. Head to our Transfer Guides page for more details on the credit transfer process. The School of Engineering Admission Recommendations for Transfer Students : This page shows the SCU Core and School of Engineering courses recommended for transferring to Santa Clara University. While there are no transfer requirements, we recommend prioritizing the following in your application. Bachelor of Science in Engineering Majors: Bioengineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, General Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Web Design and Engineering Two English composition courses Two calculus courses One general chemistry course Two calculus-based physics courses GPA 3.5 You may also choose to complete other SCU Course requirements listed below before transferring. *NOTE: There is no Second Language requirement for Engineering majors and the Arts requirement will be fulfilled in the School of Engineering at SCU. Additional recommendations specific to your Engineering major of choice can be found on the Transfer Guides page.
notes.contentHtml:
Thank you for your interest in Santa Clara University! This guide has been designed to help make the course-planning process easier for students who wish to transfer to Santa Clara University. Head to our Transfer Guides page for more details on the credit transfer process.


The School of Engineering Admission Recommendations for Transfer Students:

This page shows the SCU Core and School of Engineering courses recommended for transferring to Santa Clara University. While there are no transfer requirements, we recommend prioritizing the following in your application.


Bachelor of Science in Engineering Majors: Bioengineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, General Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Web Design and Engineering

  • Two English composition courses
  • Two calculus courses
  • One general chemistry course
  • Two calculus-based physics courses
  • GPA 3.5


You may also choose to complete other SCU Course requirements listed below before transferring.


*NOTE: There is no Second Language requirement for Engineering majors and the Arts requirement will be fulfilled in the School of Engineering at SCU. Additional recommendations specific to your Engineering major of choice can be found on the Transfer Guides page.

notes.content: Structure of Santa Clara University General Core To view the Santa Clara University core curriculum requirements check out our Core Curriculum page. Some Core requirements must be met at SCU: Civic Engagement, Religion Theology & Culture 2, Science Technology & Society, Religion Theology & Culture 3, Experiential Learning for Social Justice, Advanced Writing, and Pathways. Moreover, no courses listed in this guide can fulfill more than one core requirement. Navigating this Guide The first courses listed on this page are the recommended courses for admission to SCU . We do not have particular requirements for transferring, but we do recommend you complete most of the courses tagged as "Recommended Courses" below and meet the recommended GPA. The remaining courses listed will fulfill university core requirements or School of Engineering requirements. *NOTE: Courses with a co-requisite must be completed together to meet the requirement FOR MORE DETAILS ON SPECIFIC ENGINEERING MAJORS PLEASE SEE THE BOTTOM OF THE TRANSFER GUIDE FOR YOUR COLLEGE. The articulation of some major requirements follows the core requirements.

notes.text: Admission Recommendations for the School of Engineering

Thank you for your interest in Santa Clara University! This guide has been designed to help make the course-planning process easier for students who wish to transfer to Santa Clara University. Head to our Transfer Guides page for more details on the credit transfer process.

The School of Engineering Admission Recommendations for Transfer Students:
This page shows the SCU Core and School of Engineering courses recommended for transferring to Santa Clara University. While there are no transfer requirements, we recommend prioritizing the following in your application.

Bachelor of Science in Engineering Majors: Bioengineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, General Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Web Design and Engineering
Two English composition courses
Two calculus courses
One general chemistry course
Two calculus-based physics courses
GPA 3.5

You may also choose to complete other SCU Course requirements listed below before transferring.

*NOTE: There is no Second Language requirement for Engineering majors and the Arts requirement will be fulfilled in the School of Engineering at SCU. Additional recommendations specific to your Engineering major of choice can be found on the Transfer Guides page.

Structure of Santa Clara University General Core

To view the Santa Clara University core curriculum requirements check out our Core Curriculum page.
Some Core requirements must be met at SCU: Civic Engagement, Religion Theology & Culture 2, Science Technology & Society, Religion Theology & Culture 3, Experiential Learning for Social Justice, Advanced Writing, and Pathways.
Moreover, no courses listed in this guide can fulfill more than one core requirement.

Navigating this Guide

The first courses listed on this page are the recommended courses for admission to SCU. We do not have particular requirements for transferring, but we do recommend you complete most of the courses tagged as "Recommended Courses" below and meet the recommended GPA. The remaining courses listed will fulfill university core requirements or School of Engineering requirements.

*NOTE: Courses with a co-requisite must be completed together to meet the requirement

FOR MORE DETAILS ON SPECIFIC ENGINEERING MAJORS PLEASE SEE THE BOTTOM OF THE TRANSFER GUIDE FOR YOUR COLLEGE.

The articulation of some major requirements follows the core requirements.
